title: Live update (topic ul/v1/d/{id}/live/{out}, not retained, QoS 0, server to device)
description: Partial update while a slider is held, at most 20 per second per output after server coalescing. Applied on top of the current state with a hardware fade of fade_ms (default 60, slightly longer than the 50 ms update interval so steps blend). Shares the seq counter with set; when the finger lifts the server publishes the final value as a retained set with a higher seq.
